title: Studio: picklist page and 「use picklist」 in the object designer — the objectui half of objectstack#18164 (phase 2)
body:
Ruled: 6006062645 · letter A′ · 2026-10-06T00:07Z
Release: claim 5967957684 (epic PM `session_016tKoy8NJa35Yih1FdzrVmn`, `hotlong`) released by the director seat, summon #34 (`session_0195diSK6vuqxgiJ38VWBHb6`), on the maintainer's order 「决定 objectui#10202 是继续还是放手」 · cause: abandoned in flight with no takeover · destination: `pm:queue`, `domain:ui` lane · the trunk-based branch and its worktree are not reused
~~Claimed: 5967957684 · epic objectstack-ai/objectstack#18164 · base: the 17.6.0 trunk `claude/issue-11438-objectstack-17-6-0` (objectstack-ai/objectui#11531); lands after it · 2026-10-03T09:53Z~~
Road order: lifted by the maintainer's order (see 5967926862); the `domain:ui` lane takes this card at its next slot
Path: 本地跑起来、看到 — studio-authoring (清单项待写) | P2

Sub-issue (objectui half) of objectstack#18164 (shared picklist / global value set), filed by the director seat, summon #25 (`session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`) under ruling batch #209 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「18164 同意」 (2026-09-21, chat). ⛔ Not a claim. Position in the road: step ②「本地跑起来、看到」, records/studio. The design of record is the batch #147 item 2 ruling on the parent (comment 5715762696), reproduced here only where this layer needs it. **Scope corrected by ruling 6006062645 (batch #280 item 1, A′): the consumer surface follows the protocol, which declares the `picklist` kind package-owned with no runtime create (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts:825`, `allowRuntimeCreate: false`).**

## Scope (the frontend layer — `domain:ui`, this repo)

Phase 1 needs nothing here: the runtime serves select fields with resolved `options`, so renderers, validation and filters are unchanged. Phase 2, this card:

1. **「use picklist」 in the object designer's select-field editor** — a picker over the picklists the runtime serves, by name; choosing one sets `picklist` and clears inline `options`; inline options are refused on a picklist-bound field (the spec refuses both). This is the authoring entry ruling 5995552118 (batch #279 item 2B) names for `field.picklist`.
2. **The field save path drops the served, resolved `options` whenever `picklist` is set, before the PUT** (producer obligation 5925784898; server pin `packages/objectql/src/protocol-picklist-served-roundtrip.test.ts`). Without it a GET → edit → PUT of any object with a picklist-bound field is refused with 422.
3. **A Studio picklist page, READ-ONLY** — name, label, options with per-option label, extensions with their owning package. ~~list, create, edit the package-owned picklists~~ ⛔ No create, edit or delete: struck by ruling 6006062645, since the protocol takes no runtime create for this kind. A runtime-authored picklist would be a protocol change on its own card, never a consumer-side offer.
4. ~~the console pin bump that carries the spec/runtime halves~~ Done: objectui `main` resolves `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0 since objectstack-ai/objectui#11531.

Base at the next claim: objectui `main`. `Clause-②` is the claim's to state; the expected answer is `no` (a consumer surface over the served field shape).

## Acceptance

A studio-authoring checklist item (authored here): a picklist authored in a package is referenced from two objects' select fields in the designer; both objects' forms show its options without a rebuild; the designer refuses inline options on the bound field; a GET → edit → PUT round trip of an object with a picklist-bound field succeeds. `pnpm objectui:refresh` flows the build back to objectstack per the multi-repo rule.

Dedupe words: picklist page, use picklist, object designer select field, global value set, studio.
